spans.s: Dikaios (IE 8-2) Greek; royal title; ‘pious’; translated in Prakrit as Dhramika (Sanskrit Dhārmika).
Dikpāla (HD), probably, officers in charge of the borders of a kingdom. See Nārada, Jolly's ed., Pariśiṣṭa, verse 17; Mitākṣarā on Yājñavalkyasmṛti,
dīkṣā (HA), initiation as a monk or recluse; initiation into any doctrine.
Dīkṣita (EI 22; CII 3, 4), same as Yajña-dīkṣita; epithet of Brāhmaṇas; later stereotyped as a Brahmanical family name.
